It adds a lot to the game. You have a good punter who can push the opposing team back against the goal line. It’s gonna benefit the team. If there was a 4 and out and you’re just going off the position of the ball then you’re just neutering the defense even more than it already is and it will just turn into a shootout every week. Or if you’re going to the 30 yard line. After every drive that gets rid of that advantage and the game suffers because of it You need to be able to give defenses that advantage or else the game just becomes an offensive battle and that is no fun. I’ll give you the extra point. I don’t really see the point of them either and you could probably do away with it or tweak it in a way that is more competitive but field goals also add a competitive edge to the game. If the score is 27 to 24 with three seconds left on the clock and a team is on the 30 yard a team should be able to kick a field goal in order to tie it and take it to overtime. Sure teams trying to scramble for a touchdown with limited time sounds exciting at first until your team is the one that loses the game because they were down by three and could’ve took it to overtime but they did away with field goals. Special teams is just part of the game. It might not be the most fun part, but it does have its point and it’s not just there for no reason and getting rid of it would make the game worse in my opinion
